reviewNotes: PlanModulo is an explicit entitlement contract and does not reinterpret PlanLimite as a boolean feature flag.
PoliticaModulosSaaS requires server-side tenant identity to equal the target Empresa and verifies the subscription belongs to that tenant and is currently valid.
The effective persisted Plan identity must match Suscripcion.PlanId; missing, inactive or unsaved plans fail closed.
Rules bind both PlanId and normalized PlanCodigo, preventing a stale entitlement from surviving a plan-code change.
No wildcard exists: a module is enabled only by an active explicit rule for the effective plan and normalized module key.
No production FREE/PRO module assignment is invented in this DOMAIN parent; test-only rules exercise the contract without becoming product policy.
No migration, DbContext mapping, repository, API, frontend, deploy, production, secret or PR #2 change is included.

candidateSupersessions.cause: REVIEW_FIRST precheck identified plan-code/policy divergence risk; rule now binds canonical PlanCodigo and directed test covers stale-code rejection.
